summary: Round 2 fixed what the checker found, in order. (1) EEVEE white grit on the wet road: found NOT to be the stones' relief picture but EEVEE's soft-shadow noise (shadows off: grain 0.026 -> 0.008); cured as a plate setting (shadow_ray_count 4, shadow_step_count 16, 32-48 samples): road left third 0.0119 at 16 samples, 0.0078 at 48; the full-size plate measures 0.0059 on its left road patch. (2) Walls now darker wet with a wet foot (close view whole wall 0.88 of dry, lower wall 0.66; main view 0.84, lowest eighth 0.66; round 1 was 1.12 / 1.30): band measured from the cottage floor 0.9 m tall, no shine, stronger darkening, darker plinths. (3) The glb maps are insurance, not the wet look of the film (stage check repeated: same result; specularity map changes the road by 0.006, roughness map by 0.28). (4) Wet road now 1.50 times today's in EEVEE; puddles rounder (40 % Lowness, softer edge), dial refitted; one FULL-SIZE EEVEE wet plate with the lockout props drawn (1536x2730, 32 samples, 20 min 27 s); the painter was NOT run (costs money, needs your go-ahead; brief must change first). (5) Flags wet roughness 0.35, Relief Flatten 1.0. (6) Sett-corner glints softened (smoothed relief, Relief Flatten 0.7) but still visible as short ticks. (7) Heavy-rain puddles rounder; pavement puddles grow too fast at dial 0.8 (35 %). (8) glb flat stand-ins now 1.03 to 1.13 times live (were 1.23 to 1.70); maps/ground and walls baked again, glb rebuilt. Blender runs: 18 (budget ~10), five of them the search for the grit's cause.
wetness_layer: WETNESS node group (tools/wetness_layer.py), 35 inputs, 11 outputs, sits between a material's dry look and its Principled BSDF. NEW in round 2: Wet Normal (vector; a smoothed copy of the relief picture, make with tools/20_make_smoothed_pictures.py; unplugged = the dry normal) and Grain Fill (0..1, default 1: how far wet ground slides from the sharp relief to the smoothed Wet Normal before Relief Flatten flattens it further); Film Coat (0..1, default 0.3, was fixed 0.3: coat weight of the water film outside puddles, 0 for walls). Other controls (default): Wetness 0.8 (0 = dry look unchanged); Puddles 0.5 (recalibrated: threshold = 0.79 - 0.52 x dial^1.25, main camera road 2.9/8.1/14.9/30.1 % at 0.3/0.5/0.65/0.8); Seed 0; Porosity 0.6 (how much it darkens; walls 1.0); Darkest 0.45 (how dark a soaked porous surface gets; walls 0.2); Wet Roughness 0.3 (soaked roughness: road 0.3, flags/kerbs 0.35, walls 0.9 = dry, so walls only darken); Puddle Roughness 0.08; Specular Boost 0.25 (0 for walls); Relief Flatten 0.35 (road 0.7, flags 1.0); Puddle Darkness 0.9; Puddle Bias 0 (pavements 0.22); Lowness 0.5 (given by caller); Dry Tops 0.5; Water Level 0.65; Ground Slope 0.0699 and Ground Offset 0 (walls in their own coordinates: 0 and 0, band measured from the cottage floor); Wall Band 0.45 m (walls 0.9, dressed stone 0.6); Wall Wetness 0.35; Streaks 0.5; Drip Mask 0 (WETNESS DRIP sub-group: streaks under every sill and the eaves); Use World Geometry/Position/Surface Up; five effect switches. Puddle depth shares now 40 % wobble / 40 % Lowness / 20 % relief, edge softness 0.10. Outputs: Colour, Roughness, Specular IOR Level, Coat Weight, Coat Roughness, Normal, Height, Wet/Puddle/Streak masks, Puddle Depth. Maps it writes (by photographing from above): wet colour, roughness (glb metal-roughness G), clear coat (clearcoat R) + coat roughness (G, one picture), specularity (specular picture alpha, colour factor 1.5), wet normal (checking only), puddle and wet masks.

Plate render settings recommended for the film's own plate script (not changed there): ray tracing on, shadow_ray_count 4, shadow_step_count 16, 32-48 samples. All work on copies; the film project was not touched (no file modified).

stage_check: Done in the copy of the film kit's stage (stage_test/, three.js 0.169, hidden Chromium with software graphics, the kit's real projected-set.js), with the re-baked wet glb and the round 2 EEVEE wet picture as the stand-in painting. (1) Maps arrive: describe shows roughnessMap, clearcoatMap, clearcoatRoughnessMap, specularIntensityMap (all texture channel 1 = UV2) and specularColor 1.5 on street_setts_wet, pavement_flags_wet, channel_stones_wet and the 4 wall materials; normal map on channel 0 (now the smoothed relief picture). Exported file read directly: extensions clearcoat, specular, emissive_strength. (2) They change the picture, roughness map by far most: road mean 0.220 today glb, 0.178 wet glb maps off, 0.461 + roughness map (+0.28), 0.491 + clear coat maps (+0.03), 0.485 + specularity map (-0.006: the specularity map changes the road least and does not make anything wet by itself). Own stand-in dusk, much brighter than the stage's. (3) They do NOT reach the film today: through projectPaintingOnto 1.97 % of a moved view wears the glb's own surface; today's glb vs wet glb differ by 0.0004; matte on vs off by 0.0024 (0.0011 on the road); plate view equals the painting (0.0036 on the road). So the film's wet look is whatever the painter paints from the plate; glb maps are insurance. If live reflections ever matter: matte off for the ground only and re-tune the stage's match tint (about 1.6-2.5 down to about 0.29, round 1 measurement). Stage check was run on the first round 2 glb (flat stand-in colours were fitted afterwards; only flat materials changed).

Close views 640x480 24 samples: 78-170 s. Lockout file (props, lights): 540x960 16 samples 220-227 s; FULL-SIZE plate 1536x2730 32 samples rays 4/16: 1227 s (20 min 27 s), ~7 GB memory. Quick calibration run (puddle sweep, colour ratios, wall masks in one Blender run): ~2 min. Bake 8.5 min (round 1: 13 min); glb rebuild --reuse 7 s of work. Stage test: still 7-8 s, projected still 12-20 s. 18 Blender runs in round 2 (budget ~10; five were the speckle search).
failures: Looked for the speckle in the wrong place for five runs: the first test (border render of the lower-left part) showed no speckle in ANY variant including round 1's, so it said nothing; the whole-picture test showed it did not depend on the relief picture; ray tracing size/quality, clamps, shadow memory, lamp size, shadow map size, taking away each picture all failed to change it; only switching shadows off (0.008) and then shadow rays 4/steps 16 found and cured it
